figurative_meaning_en: Harsh or rude in speech; arrogant or bold
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে উচ্চভাষী লোক, সবসময় অন্যদের অপমান করে।
উচ্চভাষী হয়ে কথা বললে কেউ শুনবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a high-talker, always insulting others.
Speaking in a high-handed manner won't get anyone to listen.
note: Refers to someone who uses lofty or abrasive language to assert superiority
